From global learning platforms, courses and certifications to career mobility, leadership development and continuous feedback, HP provides an environment designed to support your growth.Growth is a two-way proposition. We’re looking for someone who brings ambition, curiosity, and entrepreneurial spirit and is ready to:- Step up and take responsibility rather than wait for direction- Take on challenges and stretch beyond the comfort zone- Use sound judgment, including when decisions need to be made with incomplete information- Challenge the status quo constructively and find simpler, faster, or more effective ways of working- Proactively remove obstacles rather than wait for direction- Learn continuously from both successes and setbacksIf you are commercially minded and energized by the opportunity to own a meaningful part of HP’s Consumer business across DACH, this role offers the opportunity to make a visible impact and shape your next career step at HP.The RoleAs Consumer Area Category Country Manager (m-f-d), you will own end-to-end product-line management and drive the growth and profitability of a defined part of HP’s Consumer Personal Systems (CPS) portfolio across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.You will have product-line P&L and quota accountability for Consumer HW & Services and take ownership of revenue, unit volume, and Owned Gross Margin.This is an individual-contributor role, not a people-manager role. Manage product transitions in close coordination with Business Management and Pricing.- Entrepreneurial Ownership: Act like an owner of the business. jobs.occupation: Staff Network Reliability Engineer (f/m/d) / 1610 (Site Reliability Engineer)
jobs.description: About IONOSAt IONOS, we don't just manage servers – we shape the digital future for more than 6.2 million customers worldwide with our solutions. As Europe's leading hosting provider and a pioneer in independent cloud solutions, we are building next-generation infrastructure – from sovereign cloud architectures and high-performance GPU clusters to integrated AI automation tools.What drives us is digital sovereignty for Europe and real impact for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) as well as large enterprises. We work in agile teams, rely on transparent structures, and believe that excellence and innovation only emerge through true team spirit.Ready for your next step? Become part of IONOS and grow with us.NRE Operations runs the data center networks for the entire IONOS group: the physical fabric and underlay, the SDN overlay, and the virtual network functions on top, across dozens of data centers. We are looking for a senior or staff-level engineer who operates large production networks with a reliability mindset. You define what "healthy" means, catch problems before customers do, lead the hardest incidents, and partner with NRE Automation to push routine operations toward zero manual steps. AI is central to how we work, both to make the network smarter and to make each engineer faster.We expect every engineer here to be fluent with AI, and we mean it in two concrete ways. First, applying AI to the network itself: anomaly detection, automated diagnosis and root-cause analysis, config generation and validation, smarter alerting, and runbook or agent-driven automation. Second, using AI to raise your own output: coding assistants and LLM tooling for scripting, troubleshooting, research, and documentation. Reliability work punishes blind trust, so the skill that matters most is judgment. You need to know when an AI-generated config or diagnosis is trustworthy and when it is not.Tasks- Own reliability of the physical fabric, SDN overlay, and virtual network functions across all IONOS data centers. Set service level objectives and drive down unplanned downtime.- Lead incident response on major network incidents and run postmortems that produce lasting fixes.- Remove toil through automation, working with NRE Automation on pipelines and tooling for lifecycle, patching, and service configuration.- Apply AI to operations: anomaly detection, automated diagnosis, config generation and validation, and automated remediation, with the judgment to know when AI output is trustworthy.- Strengthen observability so problems surface before they reach customers, and shape lifecycle, upgrade, change-management, and capacity practices.- Collaborate with NRE Provisioning on clean handovers.- Share the on-call rotation covering the above.Qualifications- Extensive hands-on experience operating large-scale production data center networks (5+ years for Senior, longer for Staff).- Deep Layer 2 and Layer 3 knowledge: routing (BGP, OSPF) and VXLAN with BGP/EVPN.- Multi-vendor operations across Juniper and Cisco; SONiC and Netbox familiarity is a plus.- Strong Linux fundamentals and the toolkit that goes with them (bash, tcpdump, iptables, git).- Network automation you have built, using Python with Ansible and CI/CD on GitLab.- A reliability-engineering mindset: SLOs, observability, incident command, postmortems, designing out toil.- Fluent, critical use of AI in daily engineering, plus a track record or credible ideas for applying AI to network operations.- Fluent English for international teams; German is a plus. Ownership and a calm approach when things break.Benefits- Hybrid working model.- Flexible working hours through trust-based working hours.- At some locations a subsidized canteen and various free drinks.- Modern office space with very good transport connections.- Various employee discounts for activities and products.- Employee events such as summer and winter parties, as well as workshops.- Numerous training and development opportunities.- Various health offers, such as sports and health courses.

jobs.occupation: Associate Scientist Quality Control in vivo (f/m/d) (Biowissenschaftler/in)
jobs.description: - Fixed-term employment contract with a duration of two years –  Would you like to be part of a crucial division of our quality organization, ensuring stable supply of vaccine to patients around the globe? Are you familiar with all aspects of in vivo studies and aim for practical, real-world applications of your scientific knowledge? Does “ensuring patient safety” feel like a meaningful use of your scientific skills? Then you might just be our new Associate QC Scientist.Join our in vivo studies team and become an integral part of the growing QC department in Martinsried/ Munich!The local QC department consists of about 80 colleagues who, together with sister departments situated in Denmark and Switzerland, form an important part of our quality organization. With the QC in vivo team of approx. 20 colleagues (scientists, lab technicians, and animal technicians), you will operate a BSL3** animal facility under GMP standard and release in vivo tested TBE and Rabies vaccine products. In this function you will report to our Manager QC in vivo.Your responsibilities include:- Plan, supervise and execute quality control experiments in vivo (in mice) under GMP for the release of vaccine products in a BSL3** animal facility- Work as part of the scientific leads team of QC in vivo, and coordinate both scientifically and organizationally within the QC department- Ensure testing readiness, including qualification and validation of equipment and laboratories, and overseeing sample flow, reagent and material logistics- Maintain GMP quality standard, including authoring and reviewing GMP documents, and working within the Quality Management System- Support in planning and alignment with different stakeholders across departments- Support in hosting inspections and audits, and in communicating with animal welfare and GMP authoritiesAbout you- Post-graduate academic education bio/life sciences (PhD/Dr. rer. nat./Dr. med. vet. in relevant field) and preferably 2-3 years of work experience in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry- Hands-on experience in coordination, supervision and documentation of in vivo studies in mice/rodents and knowledge of German animal welfare legislation- Experience with GMP quality standards, preferably experience with equipment qualification and laboratory coordination- Flexible and proactive working style in a dynamic environment, excellent time management skills and ability to meet deadlines while ensuring the diligence and quality of your work- Excellent written and spoken command of English language (German language skills are of advantage)We offerA chance to enhance your skills and gain unique industry experience in the exciting combination of in vivo studies under GMP and biosafety level BSL3**.A chance to work in an international company with unique technology and a dedicated work force. We offer a dynamic work environment and an opportunity to develop both your personal and academic competencies. You will be a part of a diverse and international team with a strong work ethic and focus on a respectful and enjoyable work environment with a strong team spirit.For us, it is all about improving and saving livesImproving and saving lives through innovative vaccines is at the heart of what we do in Bavarian Nordic. We are a fully integrated vaccine company focused on the development, manufacturing, and commercialization of life-saving vaccines, and our vision is to become one of the largest pure-play vaccine companies in the world.In Bavarian Nordic, we believe in the power of the team, and you will be part of a global team of more than 1800 dedicated employees with diverse backgrounds and viewpoints, who are bound together by our commitment to protect lives every day.
